info.title: NTL ATLAS Qwen3 8B v1
info.subtitle: Atlas adapter for LLM competition
info.description:
An ATLAS adapter for Name That LLM, trained on the official 2,699 training
rows for five epochs with frozen Qwen3-8B-Base. The package contains 18
source-specific adapters, inference code, configuration, and provenance.

**Licenses:** The adapter weights and package documentation are **CC BY-SA
4.0**. The bundled Python code is **Apache 2.0**. See `LICENSES.md`,
`LICENSE-WEIGHTS-CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt`, and `LICENSE-CODE-APACHE-2.0.txt` for the
scope and full terms. Kaggle's “Other” field refers to this combination.

Credit the adapter to Joseph Adamski (`josephadamski91`) and link to this
dataset when reusing it. The [ATLAS method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19583)
is by Minseok Ko and coauthors. The
[Qwen3-8B-Base model](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base) is by the
Qwen Team and is Apache 2.0. The official training data is provided through
[Name That LLM](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/name-that-llm) under the
competition's CC BY-SA 4.0 data terms.

The base model weights and training CSV are obtained separately. Their terms
and the licenses of third-party dependencies remain applicable. See
`CREDITS.md` for attribution and provenance.
info.userSpecifiedSources:
Credits
Adapter: Joseph Adamski (josephadamski91), NTL ATLAS Qwen3 8B v1. Trained for five epochs on the official 2,699-row Name That LLM training set.

Base model: Qwen3-8B-Base, Qwen Team, Apache License 2.0. The base model was frozen during adapter training. The package distributes the learned source-specific adapters and control embeddings; the full base model is obtained separately. Base revision: 49e3418fbbbca6ecbdf9608b4d22e5a407081db4.

Training data: Name That LLM, provided by Google LLC through Kaggle. The competition rules specify CC BY-SA 4.0 for data access and use. The data was used to train the adapter and is not redistributed in this package. Obtain it from the competition page under its applicable terms. Training CSV SHA256: 40a22ce8d88c5f46feb4637a099db815bef5f713ffe53e89dbe1b7b21de77707.

Method: Minseok Ko, Hyunseok Lee, Woomin Song, Beomjun Kim, Jinwoo Shin, and Kunwoong Kim, Who's Behind the Text? Robust Model Authorship Attribution,

ATLAS is their method. This package implements it in PyTorch for the competition's 18 model labels. It does not distribute the authors' reference code, pretrained adapters, or MAABench data.
External dependencies, including PyTorch, Transformers, NumPy, and Safetensors, are obtained separately and retain their respective licenses.
